comment: Curated slugs for the lettered TLG sub-edition ids (tlg0007.tlg082a etc.) that First1K/Perseus split out of a parent canon work. The TLG canon has no entry for a lettered id, so build_id_crosswalk.py cannot mint a slug from it; entries here supply the author slug and title, and the builder mints slug = author_slug + '.' + normalize_slug(title). Evidence per entry: the source TEI title plus the canon parent.
